summary_rationale: Evaluated strictly on price-blind operating fundamentals, Vertiv Holdings Co. qualifies as a COMPOUNDER_PASS with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health. Following its 2022 fixed-price backlog crisis (gross margin 28.4%, FCF -$263.8M, Net Debt/EBITDA 5.80x), CEO Giordano Albertazzi and Executive Chairman Dave Cote instituted dynamic price-cost governance and the Vertiv Operating System (VOS), driving FY2025 revenue to $10,229.9M (+27.7% YoY), GAAP operating profit to $1,829.7M (17.9%), Free Cash Flow to $1,887.4M (141.6% of net income on 2.2% capex intensity), ROIC to 22.3% (23.9% TTM), and Net Debt/EBITDA down to 0.62x. Momentum accelerated further in 2026: Q3 2026 revenue reached $4,312.8M (+61% YoY), organic orders grew >100% YoY, adjusted operating margin hit 25.2% (clearing the Nov 2024 Investor Day 2029 target three years early), and 9M 2026 sales ($10,236.6M) surpassed all of FY2025. Vertiv's moat combines ~5,000 global field service engineers across ~320 service centers, NVIDIA Blackwell/Vera Rubin reference co-design, and targeted M&A (CoolTera, Great Lakes, Waylay, and the $1.0B PurgeRite deal). Watch items justifying PASS_WITH_WATCH include: (1) discontinuation of quarterly exact dollar backlog disclosures in 2026 in favor of order growth/coverage ranges, (2) hyperscaler customer concentration and OCP insourcing risk, (3) DSO at 110.9 days on $3,109.0M year-end receivables, and (4) inherent cyclicality if AI data center capex pauses abruptly.
